crossRefs.note: Also in the third year of his reign he sent his princes, even Ben Hail, Obadiah, Zechariah, Nethanel, and Micaiah, to…
Then Eliashib the high priest rose up with his brothers the priests, and they built the sheep gate. They sanctified it…
Next to them, the Tekoites made repairs; but their nobles didn’t put their necks to the Lord’s work.
Charge those who are rich in this present world that they not be arrogant, nor have their hope set on the uncertainty…
that they do good, that they be rich in good works, that they be ready to distribute, willing to share;
But as for you, stand here by me, and I will tell you all the commandments, and the statutes, and the ordinances, which…
Moses commanded us a law, an inheritance for the assembly of Jacob.
For Yahweh is our judge. Yahweh is our lawgiver. Yahweh is our king. He will save us.
For the law was given through Moses. Grace and truth were realized through Jesus Christ.
Only one is the lawgiver, who is able to save and to destroy. But who are you to judge another?
They traveled from Iyim, and encamped in Dibon Gad.

people.name: Mattanah
people.line: A place where the Israelites camped during their wilderness journey

translations.web: the well, which the princes dug, which the nobles of the people dug, with the scepter, and with their poles.” From the wilderness they traveled to Mattanah;
translations.bsb: The princes dug the well; the nobles of the people hollowed it out with their scepters and with their staffs.” From the wilderness the Israelites went on to Mattanah,
translations.kjv: The princes digged the well, the nobles of the people digged it, by the direction of the lawgiver, with their staves. And from the wilderness they went to Mattanah:
translations.asv: The well, which the princes digged, Which the nobles of the people delved, With the sceptre, and with their staves. And from the wilderness they journeyed to Mattanah;
